content: प्रत्यादेशः .²1 An order, a command. .²2 Information, declaration. .²3 Refusal, denial, rejection, repulse, repudiation; प्रत्यादेशान्न खलु भवतो धीरतां कल्पयामि <ls>Me. 116</ls>, <ls n="Me.">97</ls>; <ls>Ś. 6. 9</ls>. .²4 Obscuring, eclipsing, one that obscures, puts to shame or throws into shade; या प्रत्यादेशो रूपगर्वितायाः श्रियः <ls>V. 1</ls>; <ls>K. 5</ls>. .²5 Caution, warning. .²6 Particularly divine caution, supernatural warning. .²7 Reproach; न्यूनभावात्तु पश्यामि प्रत्यादेशमिवात्मनः <ls>Mb. 3. 2. 12</ls>. .²8 Prevention, defence (निवारण); तत्तदेव हरेत्तस्य प्रत्यादेशाय पार्थिवः <ls>Ms. 8. 334</ls>.
